stem:
One thousand people selected at random were questioned about smoking and drinking. The results of this survey are summarized in the table below. Calculate the probability that a randomly selected respondent drinks and smokes.

| | Smokers | Non-smokers |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Drinkers | 320 | 530 |
| Non-drinkers | 20 | 130 |

codes.response: 0.32 or any numerical equivalent such as 320/1000 or 32%. If probability is correct, disregard rounding errors.
0.032 or similar answers involving place value error.
Crossed-out, illegible, or impossible to interpret.
